PrivateBuild.PrivateTerrainWrapper: Declared flags replace only lookup_surface_flags in isolated position cases.

Limits: Actual production consumers with prepared event/level/capacity gates. Preceding quests, visible sprites and sounds are excluded.
Normal spawn chance uses the source MULT168 then XBA formula, butterfly uses byte modulo100. Whole original spawn routine is not executed by this runner.
Capacity-zero selection and private blocked/open-terrain probes check production allocations, position rolls and weak values but exclude real map collision and full spawn timeline.
Teleport controls execute actual TP_SETUP and its first no-entity animation step; destinations, full flight and collisions are excluded.
F6 cases verify serialized restoration; phone-save RNG timeline and full story are excluded.
